plugin-media-strips.name: Image & Video Strips
plugin-media-strips.description: Adds Google-style image and video rows to web results when a search asks for them.

imagesMode.label: Images strip
imagesMode.description: By default the strip appears for searches like 'cat pictures', 'mountain wallpaper' or 'eiffel tower photos'. Each strip runs one extra search on your image engines.

videosMode.label: Videos strip
videosMode.description: By default the strip appears for searches like 'how to tie a tie', 'dune trailer' or 'python tutorial'. Each strip runs one extra search on your video engines.
